title: The capture-free move count runs out at eighty plies and draws the game
rationale: Jieqi draws a game that has run forty moves — eighty plies — without a capture. Only a capture resets the count, and the first ply here is the case that says so: the piece on a1 is face down, and revealing it is as irreversible as a move gets, yet the count goes from seventy-six to seventy-seven like any other quiet move. Four quiet plies carry it to eighty and the game is drawn, automatically rather than on a claim. The boundary one ply earlier, at seventy-nine, is still ongoing, which is what makes this the rule's exact edge. Forty is this game's own number: xq-cnt-001 is the same question in Xiangqi, which counts to fifty, and Mini Xiangqi counts to nothing at all.
